mechanism: Armodafinil may increase oxycodone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction while simultaneously increasing CNS stimulation that counteracts opioid sedation, and both drugs can cause CNS depression through different pathways.
action: Monitor for reduced opioid efficacy and increased CNS adverse effects; consider dose adjustment of oxycodone if armodafinil is initiated or discontinued; counsel patient on additive CNS effects and fall risk.
